en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge crowded with people, crossing a river. Behind the bridge stands a domed mosque with a tall minaret and other low buildings. The lower part of the card is filled with handwritten text. Printed captions in Greek and French describe the scene, and "Larissa (Grèce)" appears under the image. A handwritten date in the top right reads 20/9/1904.
